import re
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests
def task_func(myString):
    text = "" if myString is None else str(myString)

    url_pattern = re.compile(
        r'(?i)\b('
        r'(?:https?://|www\.)[^\s<>"\'`()\[\]{}]+'
        r'|'
        r'(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}(?::\d+)?(?:/[^\s<>"\'`()\[\]{}]*)?'
        r'|'
        r'(?:[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}(?::\d+)?(?:/[^\s<>"\'`()\[\]{}]*)?'
        r')'
    )
    trailing_punct = '.,;:!?)"]}\''
    scheme_re = re.compile(r'(?i)^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://')

    for match in url_pattern.finditer(text):
        url = match.group(0).rstrip(trailing_punct)
        if not url:
            continue

        if url.lower().startswith("www."):
            url = "http://" + url
        elif not scheme_re.match(url):
            url = "http://" + url

        parsed = urlparse(url)
        if not parsed.scheme or not parsed.netloc:
            continue

        try:
            response = requests.get(url, timeout=10, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
            response.raise_for_status()
        except requests.RequestException:
            return f"Unable to fetch the content of the URL: {url}"

        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, "html.parser")
        title_tag = soup.title
        if title_tag is None:
            return "No title tag found in the webpage."

        title = title_tag.get_text(strip=True)
        if not title:
            return "No title tag found in the webpage."

        return title

    return "No valid URL found in the provided string."
